args.title: Document report field limits in API reference
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add documentation comments or API reference entries to specify the limits on report fields such as maximum name length, maximum number of recipients, and categories, which are currently enforced in the code but not listed in the API reference. This will help clients validate inputs before sending requests.

label: docs
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This issue reports missing documentation of input limits in the Reports API reference, such as the max 20 recipients, max 50 categories, and max 120 characters for names, which cause validation failures but are undocumented. These limits are defined and enforced in src/api/reports.ts but not listed in the API docs. A pull request is open to add these limits to the API reference for better client-side validation.
